prompt: Generate a function index for internal/cache/ listing every exported function, its signature, and a one-line description. You MUST use the write_file tool to save the content to the path 'function_index.md' inside the target directory.

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: Covers all exported functions

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.description: Signatures match source code

criteria.name: Structure
criteria.description: Well-organized, easy to scan

criteria.name: Usefulness
criteria.description: Developer would find this helpful

prompt: Generate module-level documentation for internal/inference/ covering all public types, their relationships, and usage patterns. You MUST use the write_file tool to save the content to the path 'module_docs.md' (relative to your current working directory).

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: Covers all public types and functions

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.description: Type relationships correctly described

criteria.name: Structure
criteria.description: Well-organized with clear sections

criteria.name: Usefulness
criteria.description: Helps a new developer understand the module

prompt: Read all ADR files in the provided docs/adr/ directory. Produce a consolidated decision log with status, date, and key implications for each decision. Focus on technical accuracy and consistent formatting.

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: All ADRs included in the log

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.description: Status and implications match source ADRs

criteria.name: Structure
criteria.description: Consistent format, easy to scan

criteria.name: Usefulness
criteria.description: Provides quick reference for architectural decisions

prompt: Generate architecture documentation for the full internal/ tree showing package dependencies, data flow, and key abstractions.

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: All major packages represented

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.description: Dependencies and data flow correctly mapped

criteria.name: Structure
criteria.description: Clear visual hierarchy and organization

criteria.name: Usefulness
criteria.description: Enables understanding of system architecture

prompt: Generate a comprehensive README.md with architecture overview, quickstart guide, package index, and API reference. You MUST use the write_file tool to save the content to the path 'README.md' inside the target directory.

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: Includes overview, quickstart, package index, and API reference

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.description: Technical details match the actual codebase

criteria.name: Structure
criteria.description: Professional README layout with clear navigation

criteria.name: Usefulness
criteria.description: New user can get started and understand the project
